Chargen source: assets/8x8font.png is the source of the character set. The upstream Makefile
builds build/chargen_openroms.rom from it with "pngprepare charrom assets/8x8font.png <out>"
(Makefile rule TARGET_CHR_ORF); bin/chargen_openroms.rom is that build output. No other
chargen source exists in the repository (src/ holds the KERNAL/BASIC assembly only;
bin/chargen_pxlfont_2.3.rom is the separate PXL font by Retrofan and is not used here).

Use in IronKernel 64: tools/font2c.py converts 8x8font.png with the pngprepare "charrom"
rules into fw_c64/src/font_openroms.c/.h and checks the result against
chargen_openroms.rom byte for byte. The image is already in C64 screen-code order
(upper-case/graphics set, its reverse half, lower-case set, its reverse half), so no
remapping is applied.
